statements.proposition: This change makes the About and Preferences windows open through new SwiftUI Settings and WindowGroup scenes instead of the AppKit NSWindowController classes, keeping an AppKit fallback for older macOS.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Substance matches the diff: scenes added, menu buttons use openSettings/openWindow on macOS 13+. Caveats: the NSWindowController classes are not deleted, they remain as the pre-macOS-13 fallback (so 'replacing' is about usage, not removal), and the project's MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET is 15.0 so the older-macOS fallback is unreachable in practice. Labelled on the plain reading that the windows are now opened via the SwiftUI scenes with a compatibility branch present.
evidence: Patch adds 'Settings { PreferenceSettingsView() ... }' and 'WindowGroup("关于", id: "about") { AboutView() ... }'
Patch: Button actions use 'if #available(macOS 13.0, *) { openSettings() / openWindow(id: "about") } else { PreferenceSettingsViewController()/AboutWindowController().showWindow(nil) }'
Head contents: AboutView.swift still defines class AboutWindowController: NSWindowController; PreferenceSettingsView.swift still defines class PreferenceSettingsViewController: NSWindowController
